description: The notes window: its folder through the page's own engine, and Honeycrisp's own close consent, terminal, per-file history, and reveal commands. The window loads only the bundled page, which Tauri treats as local on every platform, so no remote origin is listed. The folder plugin grants the window the notes directory: it adds the fs reading commands below for that directory alone, at run time, and makes every change and runs the folder's Git itself. Listed here without a path, the fs commands reach nothing until a grant.
